Adding a check for the array length (e.g., if len == 1) to handle the single-element case correctly is a classic validation/guard issue.
evidence_used: java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 1 out of bounds for length 1
linearCombination should check the length of the arguments and fall back to simple multiplication if length == 1.
